verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents headless batch conversion via --convert-to, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes error reporting, exit codes, or diagnostics that explain why a conversion failed (unsupported feature, corrupt input) rather than emitting a broken file. The convert/filter docs only list syntax and supported formats, which is adjacent material and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, a failed conversion reports why it failed (unsupported feature, corrupt input) instead of silently emitting a broken file
